result.description:
Senior Dairy Cattle Stockperson 
Location: Agnes, VIC 3962 
Tenure: Full-time, permanent
Salary: From $71,550 per year (plus superannuation)
 
Required skills and experience:
•	AQF Certificate III in Agriculture / Dairy Production (or higher equivalent)
•	Three (3) years of recent and relevant work experience

On behalf of our client, Global Skilled Employment we are looking for skilled candidates for Senior Dairy Cattle Stockperson that will join the production team of a dairy in Agnes, VIC 3962. 

Duties and Responsibilities:
•	Plan all aspects of milk production process including management and coordination of milking shed routines.
•	Coordinate and implement reproductive programs, including artificial insemination and herd fertility management, detection of estrous and pregnancy.
•	Assist in controlled breeding experiments to develop improved livestock strains.
•	Implement calving procedures, including the ability to physically conduct unsupervised internal assessments to minimize the incidence of still births or injuries to cow or calf.
•	Plan and manage pastures and crops for livestock production and develop livestock feeding plans.
•	Analyse produce to set and maintain standards of quality;
•	Supervise animal health programs, handle sick or injured animals and maintain an optimal environment for the wellbeing of livestock consistent with the Australian Animal Welfare Standards and Guidelines – Cattle.
•	Supervise work routines and staff performance of less experienced employees such as an assistant farmhand.
•	Implement and monitor quality assurance procedures, ensuring compliance and that all relevant documentation is kept current.
•	Operate milking plant and equipment in a safe manner, undertake multiple functions including reading and recording instrument information e.g. milk vat temperatures and cow numbers and matching cow ID to calves to produce a quality milk outcome.
•	Operate a dairy recycling system.
•	Calf feeding, including tubing colostrum
•	Assisting with and/or performing irrigation works.
•	Inspect livestock to gauge the effectiveness of feed formulae.
•	Transport, handle and store chemicals; prepare and apply chemicals.
•	Operate farm and dairy shed-related vehicles, plant and equipment.
•	Identify and report equipment not operating normally; maintenance of plant and machinery.
•	Where appropriately qualified, perform maintenance works on sheds, fixtures and fittings, fences and surrounds and install new or replacement equipment or fittings.
•	Transport stock, feed and equipment, if appropriately licensed.
•	Maintain records to ensure accurate information for stock and inventory control.
•	Ensure food safety regulatory requirements are met.
•	Contribute to and implement OHS requirements.
•	Computer literate – operate computer equipment and software packages requiring set-up and basic function operation.
•	Coordinate the response to emergencies for both occupational health and safety emergencies and animal welfare emergencies.
•	Participate in enterprise/industry training sessions and workshops as required.
 
Qualified applicants may apply online.

We are seeking experienced Logistics Officer to join our team and oversee, coordinate, and facilitate the supply chain operations of the company.

Generate final inventory of materials prior to shipment

Maintains prescribed records of goods received and dispatched
Liaise and negotiate with suppliers and retailers when required
Address issues related to damaged goods, lost shipments, or delays

Responsible for supervising and accounting for an inventory

Proficiency in MS Office and database management

Customer service skills

Strong attention to detail

result.description:
Retail Manager 

Business: FLIP OUT Gladesville
Address:  Gladesville NSW 2111
Employment Type: Full-time, Ongoing
Salary: AUD $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation

About the Business

FLIP OUT Gladesville operates as a leading indoor family entertainment and recreation centre within Australia's FLIP OUT network, providing customers with a safe, engaging, and high-quality leisure experience. The business offers a wide range of attractions and services, including trampoline activities, children's birthday parties, group bookings, school holiday programs, corporate events, café services, and general recreational activities for individuals and families.
Committed to exceptional customer experiences, safety, and operational excellence, FLIP OUT Gladesville maintains high standards across customer service delivery, workforce management, venue operations, and regulatory compliance. The business serves a diverse customer base comprising families, schools, community groups, and corporate clients, operating within a fast-paced and customer-focused environment that requires effective operational leadership and efficient coordination of multiple service offerings.
Position Overview
The Retail Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management of FLIP OUT Gladesville's daily operations, ensuring efficient venue performance, exceptional customer service, strong financial outcomes, and effective workforce leadership. The role requires hands-on operational involvement within a dynamic entertainment and hospitality environment and accountability for workforce management, customer experience, venue operations, inventory control, and compliance with all applicable workplace health and safety requirements.
This is a senior operational role suited to an experienced retail, hospitality, or leisure operations professional who thrives in a structured, customer-focused, and performance-driven environment and possesses strong leadership, organisational, and problem-solving capabilities.
 
Key Responsibilities
Venue Operations & Performance
•	Plan, coordinate, and manage the daily operations of the venue to achieve customer service, productivity, and business performance targets.
•	Ensure compliance with all workplace health and safety obligations, operational procedures, and venue safety standards.
•	Monitor key operational performance indicators including labour costs, revenue performance, customer satisfaction outcomes, and operational efficiency.
•	Coordinate venue workflows during peak trading periods, school holidays, party bookings, and special events to maintain service excellence.
•	Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, customer experiences, and service delivery standards.
•	Oversee opening and closing procedures and ensure the venue is maintained to the highest operational standards.
People Leadership & Team Management
•	Recruit, train, roster, supervise, and motivate venue employees including customer service staff, party hosts, café attendants, supervisors, and operational team members.
•	Provide ongoing coaching, performance management, and staff development consistent with business objectives and operational expectations.
•	Foster a positive and collaborative workplace culture that promotes teamwork, accountability, customer service excellence, and operational efficiency.
•	Monitor employee performance and ensure adequate staffing levels are maintained throughout trading hours and special events.
•	Promote compliance with workplace policies and ensure adherence to employment obligations and organisational standards.
Customer Experience & Service Delivery
•	Oversee customer service delivery across general admissions, birthday parties, group bookings, school programs, and café operations.
•	Resolve customer complaints and service issues promptly and professionally to maintain customer satisfaction and business reputation.
•	Maintain high standards of venue presentation, cleanliness, safety, and customer engagement at all times.
•	Coordinate customer bookings and ensure scheduled activities are delivered efficiently and in accordance with operational requirements.
•	Support customer service initiatives aimed at enhancing the overall visitor experience and encouraging repeat patronage.
Inventory Management & Cost Control
•	Manage inventory levels relating to café supplies, merchandise, operational consumables, and venue requirements.
•	Conduct regular stocktakes and monitor inventory usage, wastage levels, and operational expenditure.
•	Implement effective cost control measures to support profitability objectives and operational efficiency.
•	Ensure venue equipment, POS systems, and operational assets are maintained and functioning efficiently.
•	Coordinate with suppliers, contractors, and support service providers regarding operational requirements when necessary.
Compliance & Administration
•	Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety legislation, food safety requirements applicable to café operations, and internal operational policies and procedures.
•	Prepare operational reports, sales summaries, labour reports, booking reports, and performance documentation as required.
•	Maintain accurate records relating to staffing, inventory management, customer bookings, and operational performance.
•	Implement and monitor company policies, procedures, and operational guidelines across all aspects of venue management.
•	Support ongoing compliance audits, venue inspections, and operational assessments where required.
 
Skills & Experience

Essential Requirements
•	Proven experience in retail, hospitality, entertainment, or leisure operations management within a fast-paced operational environment.
•	Demonstrated leadership capability with experience managing teams, employee rostering, and operational workflows.
•	Strong understanding of inventory management, cost control principles, and customer service management.
•	Excellent organisational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
•	Ability to work effectively under pressure while maintaining high service and safety standards.
•	Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, school holidays, and public holidays as required by operational needs.
•	Preference will be given to suitably qualified Australian Citizens and Permanent Residents.

Preferred Qualifications
•	AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma (ANZSCO Skill Level 2); or
•	At least three years of relevant experience may substitute for the formal qualifications listed above. In some instances, relevant experience and/or on-the-job training may be required in addition to formal qualifications.
•	Previous experience within family entertainment, hospitality, retail, or customer-focused service industries will be highly regarded.
•	Current Food Safety Certification and First Aid qualifications or willingness to obtain are desirable.
•	Experience using point-of-sale systems, workforce management tools, and booking management systems will be highly regarded.
 
Work Environment
The Retail Manager role is highly operational and requires active participation on the venue floor alongside employees throughout daily operations. The position demands excellent time management skills, resilience under pressure, strong leadership capabilities, and the ability to manage multiple operational priorities simultaneously within a high-volume customer service environment. The successful candidate will be expected to lead by example, maintain operational excellence, uphold customer safety standards, and contribute positively to the ongoing success and growth of FLIP OUT Gladesville.

Based in Noosa, Australia, we've partnered with some of the world's largest corporations in personal care and agriculture to deliver our first-of-a-kind products, and we are now rapidly scaling operations to meet increasing demand.

 

We're seeking an exceptional Aquaculture Consultant (Production Technician) with experience in microalgae cultivation to join our growing production team, focused on the large-scale production of microalgae in our recirculating production facilities. This is a hands-on, science-led role: you'll apply aquaculture and environmental-science expertise to optimise cultivation and downstream processing, develop and refine protocols, and drive data-driven improvements across our operations. Based in Noosa, and working alongside world-leading experts in a purpose-driven, highly motivated team, you'll be supported with on-the-job training to help you become a world leader in the field, with opportunities for rapid career progression.

 

Key responsibilities

Maintain and optimise large-scale microalgae cultures across manual, semi-automated and fully automated systems.
Apply aquaculture and environmental-science principles to evaluate culture health, water quality and growth conditions, and identify solutions for production issues and environmental impacts.
Operate closed-system bioreactors in compliance with internal protocols and specified regulatory standards.
Study, conduct and improve downstream processing activities from harvest through to the final product.
Contribute to the ongoing development, optimisation and scientific documentation of the algae production process.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve production efficiency.
Maintain precise, accurate records to support data-driven improvements, regulatory compliance and conservation.
Skills and experience required

A degree in environmental science, marine or aquatic science, aquaculture, bioprocessing, biotechnology or a related field (or equivalent industry experience).
Demonstrated experience in microalgae/seaweed cultivation, aquaculture or large-scale biomanufacturing.
Working knowledge of bioprocessing, downstream processing and quality/record-keeping systems.
A problem-solving, can-do attitude.
Strong communication and reporting skills.
What we offer

A competitive salary of AUD $80,000–$90,000 plus superannuation.
A team-first work environment that supports personal and professional growth.
The opportunity to contribute to meaningful, purpose-driven solutions for some of the world's biggest problems.
A diverse and inclusive workplace, with a commitment to continuous learning and innovation.
Monthly team events.
Our company values

Pioneering: embrace curiosity and innovation.
Collaborative: be transparent, honest, and open to feedback.
Decisive: make bold, data-driven decisions.
Accountable: own your work and results.
Fun: create a workplace where people enjoy their work.
